# Vocabulary tells

One instance is rarely a problem. Clusters are. Several of these in a paragraph is the strongest single word-level signal.

## High-frequency AI words → plainer options

| Avoid | Try instead (or delete) |
|---|---|
| delve (into) | look at, cover, examine |
| tapestry, mosaic | mix, range — or name the parts |
| testament (to) | shows, proves |
| pivotal, crucial, vital, key (as filler) | important — or state the consequence |
| landscape (figurative), realm, sphere | field, market, area |
| underscore, highlight, emphasise (as tail) | show — or cut |
| showcase | show, display |
| foster, cultivate | encourage, build |
| garner | get, win, attract |
| enhance, elevate, bolster | improve, raise |
| intricate, nuanced, multifaceted | complex — or explain the detail |
| interplay | how X and Y affect each other |
| align with, resonate with | match, fit, appeal to |
| boasts | has |
| seamless, robust, cutting-edge | describe what it actually does |
| navigate (figurative) | deal with, handle |
| journey (non-literal) | process, career, project |
| ever-evolving, dynamic | changing — or cut |
| additionally, furthermore, moreover (sentence openers) | also, and — or no connector |
| notably, importantly | cut; let the fact carry weight |
| enduring, lasting legacy | name what remains |
| commitment to, dedication to | state the action taken |

## Copula avoidance
LLMs avoid "is/are/has". Revert:
- "serves as the headquarters" → "is the headquarters"
- "stands as a reminder" → "reminds" / cut
- "features three bedrooms" → "has three bedrooms"
- "represents a shift" → "is a shift" or say what changed

## Vague connection words
"is associated with", "is linked to", "has ties to", "in connection with" — state the actual relationship (owned by, founded, worked for).
